Saying Goodbye Well

For anyone facing an ending, from a move or a new job to a friend leaving town or a season of life closing. Each day is one small way to mark what mattered, say thank you and step toward what comes next.

Transitions · Life Transitions · Relationships · one to-do a day · you choose how many days

Start this challenge free

The first seven days

  • Day 1Take one slow breath and say quietly to yourself, "Something is changing, and that is okay."
  • Day 2Send a two line thank you text to someone who made this chapter kinder, naming one thing they did.
  • Day 3Stand in the doorway of a place you are leaving and look around slowly, as if seeing it for the first time.
  • Day 4Mark the end date on your calendar and add one word for how you hope to feel when it arrives.
  • Day 5Draw a line down the middle of a page, write this chapter on the left and the next on the right, and add one word to each side.
  • Day 6Write one sentence on a sticky note that names what is ending, then put it where you will see it.
  • Day 7Slip a brief thank you note onto the desk of a coworker who made your workdays easier.

Further into the year

The to-dos keep changing as the year goes on. A few from later in this theme:

  • Day 30Ask a friend in a new city to share one photo of their morning view, and send one of yours back.
  • Day 60Unfollow or mute one account that keeps pulling you back into a chapter you have finished, without any blame.
  • Day 120Say hello to someone new at a class, meeting or bus stop, and ask one easy question about their day.
  • Day 240Join one community group, club or class that meets near your new home, even just to look at the schedule.
  • Day 365Close your day by writing one sentence of gratitude for the ending and one for the beginning.

How a challenge works

A Theraglee challenge is a theme with one small to-do for every day of a year. You choose how long yours runs, anywhere from a week to the full year, and each day you get the next to-do: something that takes a few minutes and fits inside an ordinary day. Tick it off when it is done. Nothing is scored and nothing is lost if you miss a day; the next to-do is simply waiting when you come back.

Challenges come with a free Theraglee account, which never asks for a card. Your progress stays private to you.
